claims.evidence: Witness photos show a chest-style freezer with scuffs/used interior, but no test results or service history.
No cooling/temperature performance evidence shown in the photos.
The witness report does not show any duration rating (e.g., hours/days) or a readable spec plate.

risks.risk: Not working or weak cooling (compressor/fan/thermostat issues) — photos cannot confirm it cools to freezing temperatures.
risks.proof: A short video of the freezer running: power on, thermostat set, and a thermometer reading dropping to freezing range within a few minutes (plus a sound check of compressor/fan).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: needs repair/servicing).

risks.risk: Air leaks or bad lid gasket/seals causing poor temperature retention.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the lid gasket around the full perimeter and a simple leak test (paper strip test around the seal while closing).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible seal issue (worst case: poor retention).

risks.risk: Frost build-up, blocked drainage, or evaporator problems reducing performance.
risks.proof: Photos showing inside surfaces for frost/ice and a clip showing drainage/defrost condition (including any ice near the evaporator area if visible).
A clear photo of the rating/model plate showing model number and capacity (liters/cubic feet).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for chest freezers of this type (worst case: smaller capacity).

risks.risk: Physical damage or wear affecting longevity (hinges/lock area, bottom corners, interior floor).
risks.proof: Close-ups of hinges/lock/handle area and bottom corners, plus a straight-on shot of the cabinet for dents/rust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: cosmetic + potential structural wear).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (basket count, manual, etc.) or incomplete internal components.
risks.proof: Inventory photo(s) showing all included baskets/partitions and any missing items; show the basket attachment points.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/model plate (model number + capacity in liters/cubic feet + voltage/frequency).
Video showing the freezer powered on and cooling: thermostat set, compressor/fan running, and a thermometer reading reaching freezing range.
Close-up photos of the lid gasket/seal all around and a paper-strip seal test result.
Photos of the interior for frost/ice build-up and any drainage/defrost condition.
Close-ups of hinges/lock/handle area and bottom corners for dents/rust/cracks.
Photo showing included accessories (basket count, any partitions) and whether anything is missing.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Haier Thermocool chest-style freezer, but the photos do not confirm working condition, seal integrity, frost/drainage status, or exact capacity—these are the main factors that determine the correct Rivers NGN price.
